verdict.rationale: New Relic's own docs say you can instrument services with OpenTelemetry and integrate that data into the platform, so first-party OTel support exists. The pack never mentions OTLP as a wire protocol or a native OTLP ingest endpoint, so the 'send directly over OTLP' part is unproven. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of a native OTLP endpoint and protocol support (gRPC/HTTP), detail on which signals are supported, and independent or hands-on corroboration of direct OTLP export.

support.subject: As a developer, I can send telemetry directly over OTLP with first-class OpenTelemetry support

citations.quote: Instrument your service with OpenTelemetry and gain platform-agnostic observability.
By integrating OpenTelemetry with New Relic, you can leverage a wide range of platform capabilities to analyze the data and diagnose problems.
